card.situation: Army MICC-Carlisle Barracks solicitation for expert Microsoft Sentinel design, implementation, and operationalization for USAWC (~350 endpoints, M365 A5, NIST SP 800-53, OMB M-26-14 Optimal Tier logging, Zero Trust); Total Small Business set-aside. Reached the owner because Sooner Systems qualifies as a small business under the set-aside and holds adjacent M365/Azure and RMF/ATO capabilities, with two partial past-performance matches.
reasons_for: Firm is eligible under the Total Small Business set-aside and holds Microsoft 365 and Azure administration capability that partially aligns with the native M365/Azure ecosystem requirement [633f42f2-c4a40b6c-p1-37fce08b].
Two past-performance records (FAA cybersecurity support and Oklahoma National Guard M365 migration) provide partial technical relevance to the evaluation factors [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-8c1bf334].
22 cleared staff at Secret level and CMMC Level 2 self-assessment satisfy the IL2 access and personnel security posture expected for this DoD effort [633f42f2-c4a40b6c-p1-cf255981].
reasons_against: The firm is not listed as a Microsoft Solution Provider and no named individual holds SC-100, SC-200, CISSP, or equivalent certification required at time of offer — both are hard eligibility gaps [633f42f2-c4a40b6c-p1-ffbcd071] [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-28902381].

No Microsoft Sentinel-specific hands-on experience, no named Lead Sentinel Architect with 5+ years SIEM/SOAR design experience, and no OMB M-26-14/M-21-31 federal logging maturity experience are documented anywhere in the firm profile [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-544a9bb3] [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-39085fc7].
The solicitation response deadline has already passed (days_to_close = -4), making timely submission impossible without a formal extension [profile: fit_score gap, days_to_close = -4.0].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and SBA-eligible small business under NAICS 541512, fully qualified under the Total Small Business set-aside for this requirement.

Our team brings direct experience in Microsoft 365 and Azure administration, including a completed M365 migration and ongoing systems administration for the Oklahoma National Guard, and network administration and cybersecurity support for the FAA — both performed within the past three years. We maintain 22 personnel holding active Secret-level clearances, satisfying the IL2 access posture required for USAWC systems, and have self-assessed to CMMC Level 2.

Our cybersecurity capabilities include RMF/ATO documentation, vulnerability management using ACAS/Nessus, and SIEM/SOC support, with relevant keywords demonstrated in our FAA past-performance record. Our bench holds ITIL 4 and Security+ certifications across multiple staff members. We operate entirely within the Microsoft 365 and Azure ecosystem — the same native environment specified for all notifications, workflow escalations, and automated response actions under this PWS.

Sooner Systems understands that USAWC requires a green-field Microsoft Sentinel implementation covering approximately 350 endpoints, full M365 data-source onboarding, Zero Trust architecture alignment, and OMB M-26-14 Optimal Tier logging compliance. We are actively assessing our ability to staff a qualified Lead Sentinel Architect and Contract Manager who meet the Key Personnel requirements prior to any offer submission.

We welcome the opportunity to discuss our qualifications further with the Contracting Officer.
questions_for_co: The solicitation requires the offeror to be a Microsoft Solution Provider [633f42f2-c4a40b6c-p1-ffbcd071] — will the Government accept a teaming arrangement where the Microsoft Solution Provider designation is held by a subcontractor or teammate rather than the prime, provided the prime small business still performs at least 50% of personnel costs?

The Key Personnel certification requirement lists SC-100, SC-200, CISSP, and DoDM 8140 baseline certifications as alternatives [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-28902381] — is the Government willing to confirm the complete list of acceptable equivalent certifications, and whether a certification obtained after quote submission but before contract award would satisfy the 'at time of offer' standard?

The Lead Sentinel Architect must be named and proposed as a single individual [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-e2f56702] — may this individual be proposed as a subcontracted or 1099 resource of the prime, or must they be a W-2 employee of the prime quoter at the time of offer?

The Contract Manager must be in place upon contract award per PWS 1.23.4.3 [633f42f2-236353d8-p1-1d72f1e8] — does 'in place' require the individual to be a current employee at time of quote submission, or is a signed letter of intent from the proposed individual sufficient?

The PWS requires event logging and retention to align with the Optimal Tier under OMB M-26-14 [633f42f2-c4a40b6c-p1-1385428d] — can the Government confirm the specific log source categories and retention periods it considers mandatory for Optimal Tier compliance in the USAWC M365 A5 environment, so offerors can accurately scope and price the effort?

The Round 1 Q&A confirms this is a green-field implementation requiring the contractor to develop the initial detection catalog from scratch [633f42f2-c4a40b6c-p1-070f0d2e] — can the Government provide the approximate number of initial analytics rules, workbooks, or use cases expected at delivery, or confirm whether that number is left to the contractor's professional judgment as part of the technical approach?

reader.scope_summary: The government is procuring highly specialized commercial professional services to design, implement, and operationalize the Microsoft Sentinel platform for USAWC, requiring expert-level knowledge of USAWC's specific Microsoft 365 A5 licensing and security configuration. The contractor must onboard approximately 350 endpoints and all specified M365 data sources, achieving at least a 98% data ingestion success rate, while designing a system that complies with NIST SP 800-53 and OMB M-21-31 event logging mandates. The contractor must also deliver comprehensive training and "as-built" documentation to ensure Government self-sufficiency, with all notifications, workflow escalations, and automated response actions remaining within the native Microsoft 365 / Azure ecosystem.
reader.evaluation_basis: Technical/Past Performance (Factor 1) and Price (Factor 3) are the stated evaluation factors. The Technical Volume is evaluated for clarity, conciseness, and sufficient detail to substantiate claims. Price is evaluated using price analysis techniques in accordance with FAR 12.204. Relative weight between factors is not stated.
